notes.title: LOK Digital launches on mobile TODAY!
notes.content:
Hey there,

We're excited to announce that LOK Digital is now available on [b]Android[/b] and [b]iOS[/b] devices!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162523/daa3d454ab03508a98c4d81d84e9b9d3be5262ae.png[/img]

After our successful launch here on Steam in December, you can now take the magical world of the LOK creatures with you on the go. Check out LOK Digital on mobile:

• [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id6476513210]Apple App Store[/url]

Again, thanks for all your support with the launch here on Steam and we hope you'll be as excited for the mobile launch as we are.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2207440/LOK_Digital/

Additionally, to celebrate LOK Digital's launch, all of the Draknek & Friends games are now on sale on Steam and itch.io too! This includes LOK Digital, with our first ever sale since launch.

notes.title: LOK Digital receives an honorable mention in Excellence in Design at IGF awards

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162523/957341ec845663b5929c901bccd7610b9e0d6cb6.png[/img]

[h2]About the IGF Awards[/h2]

[i]The Independent Games Festival (IGF) Awards is the biggest annual celebration of indie talent – encouraging innovation within game development as a medium and recognizing the best independent developers from around the world. The festival sees hundreds of competition entries annually that are judged and juried by a diverse, industry-leading group of industry professionals from mainstream video games, the press, independent gaming websites, previous winners, previous finalists, and more. [/i]

Small patch to yet again fix a weird generation edge case that made the daily 3 unsolvable yesterday.

A lot of the work on this patch is on background stuff, getting ready for mobile launch. LOK Digital launches on mobile on January 23!

BUGS:
- Generator can place a word that loops over itself and the generator thinks it can be spelled, but it can't.

notes.title: 1.0.6 hotfix
notes.content:
Small localisation changes

BUG:
- Fixed generator generating unsolvable levels

I hope it's the last time you have to see this bugfix! Sorry

FEATURES:
- Added a setting to activate in-game keyboard, in case the player wants to play mouse-only, or has no english keyboard, or has some keyboard-layout related issue I have not been able to code around.

- Compressed audio slightly to reduce build size in disk by a lot.
- Progress on gamepad support: Settings menu and dailies should be usable with gamepad

- Level editor properly loads arrows checkbox, clouds checkbox, and completion seal
- Fix monument pieces sorting issues.
- Keyboard input should behave nicer with strange keyboard layouts.
- Fixed the generator rarely being able to generate an unsolvable level.
- Some fixes related to LOKBOY's power button being triggerable with gamepad from outside of its world.

notes.title: Play the new daily puzzle mode in the updated demo!
notes.content:
Hey everyone 👋

We have some exciting news to share! In case you missed it, LOK Digital was [i]just[/i] featured in [url=www.heyglitch.com/future-of-play-direct/]The Future of Play Direct[/url] with an announcement:

[h3][i][b]We've just released a brand new demo with a daily puzzle mode![/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43162523/801ffc612e331e1644b9c973e9c5e1e71a984319.gif[/img]

This demo will give both new and returning players a reason to explore the charming world of the mysterious LOK creatures. If you've already tried out the demo, there's plenty of brand new things to discover in the game, and we can't wait to hear what you think.

The update comes after recent quality of life updates we mentioned previously. For a full list of what to expect in the new demo, here's what's new:

[list]
[*] [b]Daily Puzzles[/b] - 3 brand new puzzles will be revealed every day for players to take part in.
[*] [b]Leader Boards[/b] - go up against friends, family, and the world in the daily leaderboards.
[*] [b]Quality of Life Updates[/b] - including a dictionary of discovered words, an updated hints system for those trickier puzzles, an adjustable brightness slider, and even more languages. 
[/list]

[h2]LOK Digital, Out and About[/h2]

As well as The Future of Play Direct at the Summer Game Festival today, you may also spot LOK Digital taking part in a few other exciting events in the next few months, including:

[list]
[*] Online at the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AaZCdMPqT44]PC Gaming Show 2024[/url] on June 9th
[*] Online in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] on June 10th - 17th
[*] In person at [url=https://brilliantindietreasures.com/]Brilliant Indie Treasures[/url] on July 10th (Brighton, UK)
[*] [i]…and at least two other unannounced events![/i][/list]

It's a really exciting time for us, so if you haven't already please consider wishlisting the game and telling all your friends about it. After all, puzzle solving leader boards are much more fun to take part in with friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2207440/LOK_Digital/
